ننتفع (form VIII)
# نَنْتَفِعُ (nantafiʕu) /nan.ta.fi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
# نَنْتَفِعَ (nantafiʕa) /nan.ta.fi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
# نَنْتَفِعْ (nantafiʕ) /nan.ta.fiʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَفَعَ (intafaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
